_warbucks: Warbucks Chemistry (2026-10-20): based on ATM10's settings, rescaled to this pack's coins (1 old Demigod Token = 100 coins; an iron ingot is about 24 coins, a Chapter I quest pays 100). Every service is on. tier_names/tier_quests are written by tools/build_market_prices.py.
_xp_level_price: coins for one XP level when buying levels in the Market (Enchant page / /market levels <n>)
_potions: normal effect potion price; splash x1.5, lingering x3, tipped arrow = lingering/8 each; basic = water/awkward/mundane/thick
_buyback: a sale can be bought back for the same coins within buyback_minutes (last buyback_max sales per player, lost on restart)
_sell_bin_rate: share of the normal sell price a Sell Bin pays (1.0 = full price)
_book_prices: enchanted books: one enchantment costs book_base_price + book_level_price x rarity (1-10, from the enchantment's weight) x level x (1 + (level - 1) / 4); a book sells for the sum of its enchantments x book_sell_rate; book_tier / book_treasure_tier = the shelf they're bought on
_services: coin sinks on the Bank tab: prices in coins; *_max = most a player can ever buy
_stat_step_price: Forge -> Stats: coins per step for every stat (flat rate)
_relic_xp_multiplier: every Relic / Artifact XP gain is multiplied by this (1.0 = normal), on top of a relic's bought XP Boost
_perks: Bank -> Perks: perk_step_price per stat step, perk_effect_price per effect level, flight per hour / permanent, loot booster (2x mob drops + XP) per loot_boost_minutes
_deals: Daily Deals: deals_count items deals_discount off (0.3 = 30%); Bounties: bounty_count items sell for bounty_multiplier x, up to bounty_cap items each per player per day
_fill_structure_namespaces: empty chests/barrels in structures from these mods get a fitting loot table the first time they are opened
_fill_on_generate: true: empty chests/barrels in those structures get their loot table as soon as the chunk generates (so Lootr turns them into per-player loot containers); false: only when first opened. "*" in fill_structure_namespaces = every structure
_disabled_features: switch features off for this pack: perks, flight, loot_boost, forge_stats, apoth_forge, rs_ae2_speed, chest_bonus, enchanted_books
_salvage: Salvage Station: one loot roll every salvage_ticks_per_roll ticks for salvage_energy_per_roll FE; Loot Crate Printer: printer_crates = [{id, name, coins, energy, ticks, tier}]
_forge_price_scale: multiplier on every Apotheosis Forge / reforge / affix / gem price (1.0 = default; use < 1 for packs with smaller coin values)
_tiers: Market tiers = the Demigod's Path chapters: tier_names[0] is always open; tier t opens when the team completes the main-path quest tier_quests[t-1] (written by tools/build_market_prices.py)
